title: Use the title architect only when registered
what: Hold out as an architect only if on the register of architects (bodies corporate and partnerships held out as architects must also be registered, s 38(3), (4)).

sources.title: Architectural Practice Act 2009 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A natural person must not hold himself or herself out as an architect or permit another person to do so unless registered on the register of architects
